title: Truly Subquadratic 3SUM and Truly Subcubic APSP: a Lean 4 formalization
summary: This formalization accompanies the paper *Truly Subquadratic 3SUM and Truly Subcubic APSP via Triangles in Sparse Lopsided Graphs* by Josh Alman and Virginia Vassilevska Williams. It states results of the paper as theorems of Lean 4, in the paper's notation and numbering, and proves these theorems.
